title: Concept: Caption track loaded over plaintext HTTP
description: A track element that points at plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Captions are content too, so a substituted track can change what the customer reads while the video plays.
applicability: Deployments that render a track element that points at plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Captions are content too, so a substituted track can change what the customer reads while the video plays.
